sources.title: Rejoice — English technical sheet: BK 17.006-13
sources.enumerated_scope: One-page original English sheet: the code printed in the heading and body, the Rejoice trade label and the qualification beneath its performance and production-window panels. Repeated code mentions count once.
sources.limitations: Recovery of the October 7 blank-viewer attempt, not a new source section or proof of an additional cultivar. The printed code is BK 17.006-13; BK6-13 appears only in the filename. Neither code is automatically equated with the existing catalog BK 6-13 or the earlier first-party BK3-17.006-13 and PS-BK3-17.006-13 forms. Rejoice is a trade label, not an extra variety. The document is version 1.0 but provides no publication day; the 2026/07 upload folder does not establish publication date. Performance is publisher-asserted genetic potential, subject to climate, growing conditions and agronomic practices. The production-window chart does not establish actual plantings or a growing footprint. Ordering contacts do not approve breeder, owner or license roles. Photos are visible on original page 1, but no standalone photo, reuse permission or cross-code image identity is approved. The Spanish sheet and wider regional portfolio remain unchecked.
review_warnings: The sheet prints BK 17.006-13. Its BK6-13 filename and the catalog BK 6-13 are not an approved identity match.
Earlier first-party pages print BK3-17.006-13 and PS-BK3-17.006-13 under Rejoice. These code differences need review, not automatic aliases or distinct-variety decisions.
Performance figures are company assertions with climate, growing-condition and agronomic qualifications; production windows are not confirmed planting locations.
Original sheet photos remain linked in the PDF; permission and the connection to other code forms are unconfirmed.
